_readme: Queue written by the daily-reel-render task, drained by tools/apply_additions.py during tools/sync.bat. The task must NOT edit calendar.md or review-state.json directly - it queues here instead, and sync.bat folds these in AFTER pulling, on top of whatever the desk decided today. That is what stops the two files conflicting. Adds only: an existing calendar row (keyed on date + post title) is left exactly as the desk left it, and so is an existing review-state key - with one exception, the render flip (content: awaiting-render or rerender -> in-review, plus new revisions entries), which is what tells the desk a cut now exists. It can never write an approval; see the module docstring in tools/apply_additions.py.

revisions.changed: Initial render from the approved script. Nine scenes (three-pair shape), exact CFR via encode.py; 29.50s against a 30.0s projection. 17.5.1 with both limbs, 17.5.2 and 17.5.3 quoted verbatim from rules.json and verified byte-identical against the source; 17.5 is a heading stem and was deliberately not carded, matching 17.2-17.4 in reels 28-30. Every layout prediction in the approved script held exactly: the three kickers measure 712, 834 and 826 of the 900px column and all stay at the standard 34px, so fit_kicker() never engaged, and all three main scenes end at max_y 1192 of 1310 with the detail cards at 940, 404 and 504. One deviation from the dry render: scene 6's body wraps to five lines rather than the four predicted - still 36px, fit_body() unengaged, still clear of the citation. Layout check 0 problems with no collisions; longest sustained dull-orange run 0.20s against a 0.45s threshold.
